name: apple-mcp
description: Apple MCP tools for contacts, notes, messages, mail, reminders, calendar, maps, safari, photos, and numbers (spreadsheets) integration
author: Dhravya Shah

scripts.postinstall:
npm run build:swift-helpers || echo '
⚠️  Swift helper build failed. Route analysis features will not work.

   To fix:
   1. Install Xcode Command Line Tools: xcode-select --install
   2. Build helpers: npm run build:swift-helpers
   3. Restart Claude Desktop

   Or use the Maps tool without route analysis (search, directions, guides still work).
'
scripts.setup: echo '🔧 Setting up Apple MCP...' && npm run build:swift-helpers && echo '✅ Setup complete! Route analysis is ready.'
